name: reward_bench_2_stem_binarized
description: A benchmark derived from STEM question/response data with binarized (pass/fail) reward labels that measures model ability to produce correct STEM answers under a simplified reward signal. It is intended to evaluate binary correctness prediction and reward-conditioned behavior in educational or problem-solving prompts. The dataset is compact and suited for studying binary reward shaping and model calibration on STEM tasks.
reputation: A small, specialized dataset on Hugging Face with limited community adoption outside researchers studying reward/binzarized supervision for STEM tasks.
